title: 番外二洛七七小传大婚番外一洛玄青小传
lines: （本来设计的只是一夫一妻，后来读者一直艾特我，希望七七有个好一些的结局，所以，在番外给了她，也算美满吧。这个番外，之前公众号发过，看过的可以不用看。免费的。）
噼里啪啦！噼里啪啦！
自在天，悬浮在空中的自在神山上，响起了悦耳的爆竹声。
以往只闻名难以见到的无数高手，纷纷飞了过来，一个个满脸喜悦的送上贺礼。
张悬大帝和灵犀帝尊，聂灵犀大婚！
两位神界最巅峰强者的婚礼，本来打算悄悄举行，不通知任何人，但不知如何泄露了消息，才短短半天不到，这里已经堆积的人山人海。
“云螭天，云螭大帝，金甲龙鳞衣一件，黄金龙血三升！”
“灵源天，不死帝尊，不死幻羽三根，不死帝血，五升！”
“庚金天，扶蜢帝君，虎牙三颗，虎尾两根”
玲珑仙子端坐在空中，看着手中的礼单，越念越是心惊肉跳。
这些东西，无论哪一样，放在大陆，都能让无数豪强为之疯狂，甚至帝君，都会折下面皮，亲自出手。
而在这里，只是普通的贺礼！
八大帝君，真够下血本的。
“天纵大帝，帝源丹三枚，帝境长剑，两柄”
继续向下念，玲珑仙子面皮再次一抖。
云螭大帝等人送的金甲龙鳞衣、黄金龙血等物，尽管珍贵，毕竟是帝君身上的物品炼制而成，和帝源丹、帝境长剑比，差了不止一截。
可以预见，这两样东西只要运用得好，完全可以再次造就出一位，不弱于帝君的超级强者！
如此珍贵的宝物，即便是天纵大帝，也不可能拿出第二份，竟然直接当贺礼送了
手笔真够大的！
“这恐怕是，神界出现以来，最辉煌的婚礼了灵犀帝尊，眼光还真不是一般的毒辣”
苦笑一声，玲珑仙子摇了摇头。
她是神界一诞生就出现的帝君，活了不知多少万年了，早已看惯了生死，一直不婚，是因为从未有看上的人，本想着，神界出现一位能彻底用实力征服她的人，几乎不可能，做梦都想不到，短短几十年，出现了两位！
尤其是这位张悬，彗星一样划过，第一次见到，不过是个上品巅峰神灵，连神王都没达到，短短十多天不见，就已然将其甩到了身后，成了真正纵横诸天的超级强者！
一想到那次灭世大战，就觉得心惊不已
要不是这位出手，别说九天九帝，神界还存在不存在，都说不准了。
一己之力，挽救神界关键灵犀帝尊还在凡界的时候，就看出来潜力，芳心暗许这份眼力，同为女人，让人羡慕。
“只是可惜了这个丫头”
想到二人一个为神界第一人，一个为九天之首，玲珑仙子心中就充满了无力感，为那位自己从时空乱流带来的女孩，感到不平。
这女孩对那位张悬的爱，她看在眼里，知道的一清二楚，付出了真心、付出了一切，却最终什么都得不到，即便是她，都有些于心不忍。
“我没事”
似乎看到了她的目光，洛七七转头看来，给出了个安慰的笑容，眼中却露出了无边的苦涩。
其实她一早就知道，张师没有对她动过心。
可自己却一颗真心，控制不住的给了对方，宁死无悔。
“忘记他吧，我帮你找个更好，对你真心的”玲珑仙子咬了咬牙。
content_en:
(Originally, the design was just for monogamy. Later, readers kept asking me, hoping that Qiqi would have a better ending, so I gave it to her in the extra chapter, which is considered satisfactory. This extra chapter has been posted on the public account before, so those who have seen it don’t need to read it. It’s free.)
Crackling! Crackling!
Zi Zai Tian, ​​Zi Zai Shen Shan suspended in the air, sounded the sweet sound of firecrackers.
Countless masters who were only known to be hard to see in the past flew over one after another, and each one sent congratulatory gifts with faces full of joy.
Emperor Zhang Xuan and Emperor Lingxi, Nie Lingxi are getting married!
The wedding of two of the most powerful people in the God Realm was originally planned to be held quietly without informing anyone, but the news was leaked somehow. In less than half a day, a sea of ​​people had already gathered here.
"Yun Xiaotian, Emperor Yun Xiao, a piece of golden armored dragon scale clothing, and three liters of golden dragon blood!"
"Lingyuan Tian, the Immortal Emperor, three immortal phantom feathers, five liters of the Immortal Emperor's blood!"
"Geng Jintian, Fushu Emperor, has three tiger teeth and two tiger tails."
Fairy Linglong sat in the air, looking at the gift list in her hand. The more she read, the more frightened she became.
No matter which of these things are placed in the mainland, they can drive countless powerful people crazy, and even emperors will fold their skin and take action personally.
But here, it’s just an ordinary gift!
The eight emperors are really willing to spend a lot of money.
"Great Emperor Tianzong, three Emperor Origin Pills, two Emperor Realm swords"
As she continued to read, Fairy Linglong's face trembled again.
Although the golden armored dragon scale clothes, golden dragon blood and other items given by Emperor Yunxiao and others were precious, after all they were refined from the items on the emperor's body. Compared with the Emperor Source Pill and the Emperor Realm Long Sword, they were more than a step behind.
It is foreseeable that as long as these two things are used well, it is possible to create a super strong person who is not weaker than the emperor!
Such a precious treasure, even Emperor Tianzong couldn't possibly take out a second copy, and actually gave it directly as a congratulatory gift.
What a generous gesture!
"I'm afraid this is the most glorious wedding since the emergence of the God Realm. Lingxi Emperor, his vision is really not ordinary."
With a wry smile, Fairy Linglong shook her head.
She is an emperor who appeared as soon as the birth of the God Realm. She has lived for countless thousands of years. She has long been used to seeing life and death. She has never married because she has never found anyone she likes. She originally thought that someone who could completely conquer her with strength would appear in the God Realm. It was almost impossible. She could never have imagined that in just a few decades, two people appeared!
Especially this Zhang Xuan, who passed by like a comet. The first time I saw him, he was just a top-grade peak god. He had not even reached the level of a God King. After not seeing him for more than ten days, he had already left him behind and became a truly super strong man who dominates the heavens!
When I think of that world-destroying war, I feel extremely frightened.
If it hadn't been for this man's action, let alone the Nine Heavens and Nine Emperors, it's impossible to say whether the God Realm would still exist.
Single-handedly, Lingxi Emperor, the key to saving the divine world, could see the potential when he was still in the mortal world, and secretly promised that this vision, as a woman, was enviable.
"It's just a pity for this girl"
Thinking that one of the two was the number one in the God Realm and the other was the head of the Nine Heavens, Fairy Linglong felt powerless in her heart and felt unfair for the girl she had brought from the turbulence of time and space.
She saw this girl's love for Zhang Xuan and knew it clearly. She gave her sincerity and gave everything, but in the end she got nothing. Even she couldn't bear it.
"I'm fine"
As if seeing her gaze, Luo Qiqi turned around and gave a comforting smile, but there was boundless bitterness in her eyes.
In fact, she knew early on that Master Zhang had no feelings for her.
But he was sincere and couldn't help but give it to the other person. He would rather die without regrets.
"Forget him. I'll help you find a better one. I'm sincere to you." Fairy Linglong gritted her teeth.
title_en: Extra story 2 Luo Qiqi's biography Extra story 1 Luo Xuanqing's wedding
